# gsm_project_observability_sink (Data Source)

Reads a project observability sink.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gsm_project_observability_sink" "logs" {
  project_id              = "<project_id>"
  observability_sink_name = "game-logs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `observability_sink_name` (String) Name of the observability sink
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the observability sink belongs

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `datadog_agent` (List of Object) Runs a Datadog agent for the game servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datadog_agent))
- `description` (String) Description of the observability sink
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `log` (List of Object) Sends container logs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log))
- `metric` (List of Object) Sends game server metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric))
- `node_metric` (List of Object) Sends node metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_metric))
- `trace` (List of Object) Sends traces (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trace))
- `type` (String) Sink type: one of `log`, `metric`, `trace`, `node_metric`, `datadog_agent`
